hypothesis: Token contents may affect validation costs beyond sequence length. A special-prefix indicator and its interaction with length test that possibility; the exceptional first-call cost remains unexplained by previous candidates.

pcvs.name: prompt_token_count
pcvs.rationale: Measures the token-ID scans performed by input validation.

pcvs.expression: int(isinstance(prompt, dict) and bool(prompt.get('prompt_token_ids')) and (prompt['prompt_token_ids'][0] in self.tokenizer.all_special_ids)) if self.tokenizer is not None else 0
pcvs.name: leading_special_token
pcvs.rationale: Distinguishes special-token prefixes that can change comparisons during minimum and maximum scans.

pcvs.expression: len(prompt['prompt_token_ids']) if isinstance(prompt, dict) and prompt.get('prompt_token_ids') and (self.tokenizer is not None) and (prompt['prompt_token_ids'][0] in self.tokenizer.all_special_ids) else 0
pcvs.name: special_prefixed_token_count
pcvs.rationale: Allows token-validation cost per element to differ for prompts beginning with a special token.
